inspect.dead_antennas.method: median |DATA| per antenna on 0542+498=3C147 scan 310 cross-correlations; no antenna below 0.05 x array median (lowest ea13 = 0.1852 vs median of 23 antennas near 0.25); 0.05 factor from vla_24a376_lband task_specs/r1_24a376_inspect/solve.py

inspect.bandpass_min_elevation_deg.method: casatools measures AZEL of field 0542+498=3C147 at all 63 unique timestamps, minimum = 20.483336 deg; recomputed and checked by build_vla_snr_g55.py

corroborating_quote.quote: The flux density scale/ bandpass calibrator 3C147 was observed towards the end of the session, which could result in some shadowing of antennas due to its low elevation of about 20–22 degrees.

precal.clean_false_positive_max.convention: vla_24a376_lband: build_24a376_clean.py precal_gt tolerances.clean_false_positive_max (same value in vla_3c391_cband CLEAN_FALSE_POSITIVE_MAX)

precal.masks.product: SNR_G55_10s.calib.ms (SNR_G55_10s.calib.tar.gz), FLAG + FLAG_ROW on G55.7+3.4 rows
precal.masks.method: must = online FLAG_CMD + shadow(tolerance=0) + clipzeros + quack(5 s, beg), the guide's commands in sections Online Flags / Shadowed Antennas / Zero-Amplitude Data / Quacking; target rows: neutral = flagged in the guide-shipped calibrated MS or absent from it, clean = unflagged there; calibrator rows: neutral = flagged by the guide's tfcrop/rflag/extend/manual flagdata commands run by build_vla_snr_g55.py, clean = not flagged. No per-field or per-spw percentage is stated in the guide.

corroborating_quote.quote: As a result of the flagging we have removed over 40% of the data for G55.7+3.4 and, as expected, spectral windows 0 and 2 have the most flagged data.

calibrate.verifier_tclean_recipe.quote:
tclean(vis='SNR_G55_10s.calib.ms', imagename='SNR_G55_10s.Reg.Clean.nmajor4', 
      imsize=1280, cell='8arcsec', pblimit=-0.01, nmajor=4, niter=10000,savemodel='modelcolumn')
calibrate.verifier_tclean_recipe.note: Recipe copies imsize, cell, niter, nmajor and the tclean defaults (natural weighting, hogbom, standard gridder). pblimit 0.2, pbcor and the fixed timeout follow the verifier recipe convention of vla_24a376_lband / vla_3c391_cband because the verifier gates on pb >= pblimit.

image.guide_rms_jy_per_beam.quote: The lowest rms value we found was in the order of about <math>5\cdot10^{-5}</math> Jy/beam, which we will use to calculate our threshold.

image.rms_max_factor.convention: vla_24a376_lband: build_24a376_clean.py image_gt tolerances.off_source_residual_rms_max_jy_per_beam = ref_rms * 2.0; here ref_rms = image.guide_rms_jy_per_beam -> 1.0e-4 Jy/beam (also used for calibrate tolerances.verifier_tclean_rms_max_jy_per_beam)

image.rms_min_jy_per_beam.convention: vla_24a376_lband: build_24a376_clean.py image_gt tolerances.off_source_residual_rms_min_jy_per_beam and rubric literal limit 0.00004
image.rms_min_jy_per_beam.note: RISK: only 0.8 x the guide rms; a legitimately better residual would fail this floor gate. Check against the oracle run.
